measurement: pystachy run with the JIT's cleanup (PYSTACHY_JIT_OPT unset) against LLVM's -O2 pipeline (PYSTACHY_JIT_OPT=2). Uncached: the program cache off (PYSTACHY_PROGRAM_CACHE=0), so every run compiles; rounds interleaved in rotating order, each run pinned to one CPU (taskset -c 1), PYSTACHY_TIMING=1. Hits: the program cache on, in a private cache seeded with the runtime artifacts, one traced miss per variant (not reported: a private cache's first miss also builds the runtime's shared artifacts), then interleaved traced hits. Every run printed CPython 3.13's output.

fields.wall_s: the launch's wall time, start to exit
fields.compile_s: driver.prepare_run (frontend, typed-IR passes, opt) + program.jit_load + program.jit_codegen
fields.peak_rss_mib: wait4's ru_maxrss: the largest process (driver, opt or the JIT runner)
fields.knn_s, layout_s: the UMAP probe's own stage timers (execution only)
fields.loop_s: a pyperformance port's timed loop (execution only)

input_notes: tiny.py, padded.py, imports.py, rules.txt and events.txt are tools/program_cache_probe.py's benchmark() workloads; umap_core.py is research/umap-numba-2026-11-13/umap_core.py of branch claude/dreamy-shannon-bb3cu1 at bc2df5cd, run as 10000 16 10 15 200 7
